changelog:
Initial release – turns an AI agent into an Australian migration visa file manager for agents.

- Provides document checklists for core and subclass-specific visa applications (189, 190, 491, 482, 820/801, 500, 186, 600).
- Calculates points for skilled migration subclasses (189, 190, 491).
- Guides compliant file management, onboarding, and record-keeping under OMARA Code of Conduct.
- Supplies templates for service agreements, client engagement, and application cover letters.
- Outlines triggers and exclusions for use, supporting agent compliance and audit preparation.
summary: Guide Australian registered migration agents through visa subclass requirements, client document checklists, file management obligations under the OMARA Code...
